title: Sandpoint to Spokane to Leavenworth
summary: Morning through North Idaho lake country, a Spokane city stop, then the Cascade climb into Leavenworth.
drive: Sandpoint to Leavenworth via Spokane · ~4h 30m driving · 265 mi

segments.name: Segment 1 — Sandpoint to Spokane
segments.blurb: US-95 south past Lake Pend Oreille and Lake Coeur d'Alene into Washington.

stops.name: Farragut State Park
stops.note: Former naval training station on the south shore of Lake Pend Oreille.

stops.name: Silverwood Theme Park
stops.note: Roadside landmark on US-95 between Coeur d'Alene and Sandpoint.

stops.name: Lake Coeur d'Alene
stops.note: Quick lake view as the highway skirts Coeur d'Alene.

segments.name: Segment 2 — Spokane, Riverfront Park and the Falls
segments.blurb: A few hours downtown around the falls before continuing west.

stops.name: Riverfront Park
stops.note: 1974 World's Fair site; paths along both falls channels.

stops.name: Spokane Falls
stops.note: Viewed from the park or the SkyRide gondola.

stops.name: Davenport Hotel
stops.note: 1914 landmark hotel lobby, open to walk through.

stops.name: Manito Park
stops.note: Duncan Garden and Japanese Garden, 2.5 miles south of downtown; free entry.

segments.name: Segment 3 — Spokane to Leavenworth via Cashmere
segments.blurb: I-90 to Wenatchee, then US-2 up Tumwater Canyon into the mountains.

stops.name: Cashmere
stops.note: Historic apple-country town, home of Aplets & Cotlets candy.

stops.name: Ohme Gardens
stops.note: Alpine garden overlooking the Wenatchee Valley, if time allows.

stops.name: Tumwater Canyon
stops.note: Wenatchee River canyon on US-2, the final approach into Leavenworth.

segments.name: Segment 4 — Leavenworth, Bavarian village evening
segments.blurb: Front Street on Oktoberfest opening weekend; expect crowds and full parking.

stops.name: 9th Street / Alpen Strasse
stops.note: Core of the village's Bavarian architecture.

stops.name: Front Street Park
stops.note: One of the two Oktoberfest beer-garden venues this weekend.
